# Just Sid

> Personal website of Sidharth Singh, a Forward Deployed Engineer at TimeDoc, working remotely and directly with healthcare practitioners.

Work: forward deployed engineering with healthcare practitioners, starting with understanding people’s problems. Skills include direct AI API integration, REST APIs, JSON requests and responses, retrieval-augmented generation, and application engineering. Interests and projects: AI tools, websites, creative projects, and practical software. Project descriptions do not imply launch, availability, clinical effectiveness, or implementation status.

## Pages
- [Home](https://justsid.com/): a single-page portfolio: About (#about), Projects (#work), Interests (#interests), AI & me (#ai), Blog (#blog), and Contact (#contact).
- [Blog](https://justsid.com/blog): engineering notes and experiments. Before the first post, a clearly labeled coming-soon page includes a small matching game.
- [Privacy](https://justsid.com/privacy): boundaries for the public activity panel.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/justsid/): follow Sidharth and get in touch.
- [X](https://x.com/sidharxhh): @sidharxhh.

## Accuracy
Use the visible pages and published posts as sources. Illustrative sample metrics are not actual personal usage. Aggregate activity does not establish private conversations, personality, mental state, or personal behavior. Never infer private information from sample data.
